title: 杜克能源数据中心扩张 电网升级成本谁承担
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Earnings highlighted electricity demand that continues to rise across its footprint.
segments.zh: 财报显示，其覆盖区域的电力需求持续上升。

segments.en: The company narrowed its outlook near the top end of its profit outlook, data centers are a major part of that growth story, and the company is investing heavily in grid
segments.zh: 公司将业绩指引收窄至利润预期高端附近，数据中心是这一增长故事的重要部分，公司正大举**电网升级和新增发电以满足增长。

segments.en: upgrades and new generation to meet that growth. We'll also try to keep customer costs in check, Danny.
segments.zh: 我们也会努力控制客户成本，丹尼。

segments.en: Let's discuss further, please, to say that the Duke Energy CFO, Brian Savoy, is joining us now.
segments.zh: 我们进一步讨论，请杜克能源首席财务官布莱恩·萨沃伊加入我们。

segments.en: Brian, great to see you. And look, it's a beat across all metrics.
segments.zh: 布莱恩，很高兴见到你。看，所有指标都超预期。

segments.en: I want to ask about the sustainability of this, because as you deploy roughly about $2 billion dollars a month to build out the power grid, it is ultimately customers
segments.zh: 我想问这种可持续性，因为你们每月投入约20亿美元建设电网，最终是客户

segments.en: who have to pay for that. Given what we saw on Tuesday night, given that customers and localities are pushing back against this question of affordability, can you continue these types of results?
segments.zh: 为此买单。鉴于周二晚上的情况，鉴于客户和地方政府对可负担性问题的抵制，你们能继续这样的业绩吗？

segments.en: Now, Danny, it's great to be here, and thank you for having me this morning.
segments.zh: 丹尼，很高兴来到这里，感谢今早邀请我。

segments.en: As we can, customer cost and affordability has been and always will be our priority.
segments.zh: 我们尽可能，客户成本和可负担性一直是并将永远是我们的优先事项。

segments.en: We are tasked with delivering reliable energy for customers at the lowest possible cost.
segments.zh: 我们的任务是以尽可能低的成本为客户提供可靠能源。

segments.en: In the areas we serve in the country, population growth is around 2%, which is very, very strong.
segments.zh: 在我们服务的地区，人口增长约2%，非常强劲。

segments.en: That translates into businesses and as well as data centers coming to our territories.
segments.zh: 这吸引了企业和数据中心来到我们的区域。
